days.challenge: Search one program name plus the word scam and read three results.
days.goal: Spot affiliate scams and fake programs before they cost you.

quiz.explain: Warning signs are: pay to join, promises of fast rich money, and no real product.
options: A clear product and fair pay
Pay to join, promises of fast riches, no real product
quiz.q: What are warning signs of an affiliate scam?

quiz.explain: Real programs earn from real products. Fake ones earn from new people joining.
options: Real programs earn from products, fake ones earn from new joiners
quiz.q: How do you tell a real program from a fake one?

quiz.explain: Never pay to join an affiliate program. Real programs are free to join.
options: Never pay to join. Real programs are free
quiz.q: Should you ever pay to join an affiliate program?

steps: List every program you have joined or thought about joining.
Search each name plus the word review and the word scam.
Cross out any program that asks you to pay to join.
Cross out any program with no real product to sell.
Cross out any program that promises you will get rich fast.
Keep only the programs that pass all three checks.
